name: Test Screen Reader Journey
summary: Test a bounded user journey with a real screen reader and evidence tied to interaction outcomes.
description: Test a web or application journey with a specified screen reader and browser combination, covering navigation, names, roles, state, focus, reading order, live feedback, and recovery. Use when semantic inspection alone cannot prove assistive-technology behavior.
risk_reason: This skill tests a bounded user journey with a real screen reader and evidence tied to interaction outcomes; it does not expose private spoken content or mutate production data without authority.
refuses: It does not claim screen-reader verification from DOM inspection or automated rules alone.
It does not generalize one browser and screen-reader combination to all assistive technology.
It does not expose private spoken content or mutate production data without authority.

operational.latency_reason: The skill tests a bounded user journey with a real screen reader and evidence tied to interaction outcomes, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
